answers.core: It *could* be made via an EditorPlugin, but I believe this should be a core feature of the engine as it will benefit most users.
answers.workaround: It won't be used *very* often, which is why it should be a drop-down "more" menu and not change the default behavior of "Play (F5)". But it needs to be part of the editor UI.
